The '''Blue Crescent virus''' was a [[Species/Legends|interspecies]] disease that was eliminated in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], but samples were stored on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Star Cabal]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[SCORPIO]] used the virus as a weapon against [[Cipher Nine]] in defense of [[Megasecurity Ward 23]].
